title: C.H.E.A.P. and thin. Don't bother.
text:
C.H.E.A.P. and thin. Don't bother.. I misread the description. I was searching for flannelback plastic tablecloths and this came up in the search. Considering I can only find ugly patterns in the local stores, I was happy to see a decent blue one.

Well, the color is great.
However this is dollar-store, sheet-of-thin-plastic. The kind you get for a kid's party in the park to cover a picnic table, that you'll toss out.

Ugh. Drop cloths are thicker than this thing.
Instead of a bargain, I got suckered.
Avoid.
